// PROBE (never compiled): an expiry window queried on the raw column — the
// shape churn-prevention and perk-reminder had before C-01b. Kept red so the
// guard's third rule is proven to bite.
export async function expiringSoon(db: any, now: Date, cutoff: Date) {
    const count = await db.policy.count({
        where: { endDate: { gte: now, lte: cutoff } },
    })
    const inForce = await db.policy.findMany({
        where: {
            status: "active",
            endDate: { gte: now },
        },
    })
    return { count, inForce }
}
